# Act I · The Call · Chapter Index (SEALED — DM ONLY)

> Six chapters, levels 1 → 7, about 8 sessions, Thawing to Midsummer YF 1104 (`campaign/01`). Each file is self-contained: beats with routes, scenes with NPC IDs and ledger edges, fights in the `rules/02` §4 phase template, stat blocks in the §5 template, skill challenges as chains of quick checks, side-activity windows, treasure, seeds, the level milestone and "if the party goes off-route."
>
> **Read before running any chapter:** `truth/00-index.md` (names by sound; the running rule), `truth/03-ledger.md` (before any vouch), `rules/02-tuning-notes.md` §3 (the level's row), and this index's rulings below.
>
> **Changes this folder needs in shared files** are in `_change-requests.md`. Nothing outside this folder was edited.

## 5. Rulings used across Act I

### Waking the Hushed in Act I (see `_change-requests.md` CR-A1-01)
- **DC by tier** (`rules/_handoff-notes`): **15** (L1–4) · **17** (L5–10). Charisma (Performance), an action, within 30 ft, Ash humming the tune. Bart, Thistle, Zeke or Lark can Help.
- **Half-Hushed** (grey to the elbows or shoulders; Hushed within about a season; "still in there"): **can be woken in Act I.** Borra (Ch3), the Ford Pool wolves (Ch3), half the Kessel miners (Ch5), Orla Venn (partly; Ch5), the Hollowmere conscripts and raft-guards (Ch6).
- **Fully Hushed** (grey all the way, or gone under still water at a turn of light without fighting it): **can't be woken until Ch12's duet or Ch15's discovery.** The Ch4 Bend-eels, Walt Finch (Ch4 default), the Ch6 Wall-Sleepers, Ama. Ash *feels* the difference without a roll: far, far down, something hears him, and can't climb up. That's how the player learns why "wake him later" means later.

### The call's stages (Act I)
| Ch | What Ash hears | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-campaign | Dreams of a grey lake; the tune he's always hummed | — |
| 1 | A child humming his tune, awake, at the turn of light; the locket goes cold | Near still water |
| 2 | Words: "Is anyone there?" She hears his **humming** only. Fragments: iron horns; the bird that doesn't blink. | Near still water at the turn of light (clearest at the Lane Well) |
| 3 | Places: grey water, a broken bell. **"I'm Lark."** She hears **words** at a gate. | The Ford Pool; elsewhere humming only |
| 4–5 | Words both ways at any still water at the turn of light; feelings carry (fear, cold) | Any still water |
| 6 | Close enough to follow like a rope; Ash finds her through stone | Mirrowen |

### Crossing
- Fully under a Wellgate at the turn of light, wanting it: **DC 12 Constitution save or 1 level of Exhaustion** (the drowning-dream). DC 14 if the gate is torn (Ch6 ★1 Route C). Automatic success on the Hart's back.
- **Glassy flood water** (Ch4) and other still water that isn't a crossing: going fully under is a **DC 13 Constitution save** or 1 Exhaustion for anyone struggling; an NPC who can't get up is fully Hushed.

### Bart
- Swatted **once** in Act I, telegraphed: the Grey Rooks in Captain Hoard's bell-cote (Ch6, Phase 1). Warnings without damage in Ch1 (Get the Bird) and Ch2 (Magpie nets). Ch4 and Ch5 note when *not* to target him. He comes back the next day if Ash re-summons him (10 gp incense) and is outraged about it.

### Non-lethal enemies in Act I
The Tolleys, the Magpies, the Bucket fighters and the lamp-wardens all knock out rather than kill. The Hushed don't kill either: they "keep" the downed (drag toward still water) as an objective, never an execution (`rules/02` §6).

| Ch5 | 400–750 gp | + +1 Shortsword (Uncommon; dwarven, no glimmer) · + Wand of the War Mage +1 (Uncommon; **glimmer-cored**) | Potion of Greater Healing ×2 · Spell Scroll (*Lesser Restoration*) if the Riddle Table is won |

**Totals placed in Act I:** 8 permanent magic items (1 Common, 7 Uncommon) · 10 consumables (5 Potions of Healing, 4 Potions of Greater Healing, 1 Spell Scroll). **Row gifts** (Common, 100 gp each) are at the player's choice; the natural ones are Nell's blanket (Ch2–4; pays off in the Ch4 flood) and Aggie's mug (Ch5). Log every gift in the Campaign Bible's "Gifts given" list (`campaign/05` §4).

**Glimmer-cored items** (die in Ending 1): the Wand of the War Mage +1 and every Row gift. Note it in the Campaign Bible.
